savanna.name: Savanna
savanna.tagline: Bright, curious and always in company.

night.name: Night
night.tagline: Curious minds that go far out on their own.

farm.name: Farm
farm.tagline: Sociable and grounded, at home among your people.

woodland.name: Woodland
woodland.tagline: Calm and sheltered, happy with what you know.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.blurb: Tender, organized and never forgetting. You look after the whole herd and feel it deeply.

lion.name: Lion
lion.blurb: Warm, calm and quietly in charge. You plan ahead and people feel safe around you.

cheetah.name: Cheetah
cheetah.blurb: Fast, focused and blunt. You go straight at what you want, and it runs hot when you are slowed down.

giraffe.name: Giraffe
giraffe.blurb: Tall, unhurried and direct. You see further than most, say it plainly and stay cool.

flamingo.name: Flamingo
flamingo.blurb: Colourful, warm and a little dramatic. Your feelings show, and people love you for it.

monkey.name: Monkey
monkey.blurb: Easygoing, friendly and quick to play. You swing along with the day and make it fun for everyone.

hyena.name: Hyena
hyena.blurb: Loud, spontaneous and spirited. You react fast, laugh harder and say what you think.

zebra.name: Zebra
zebra.blurb: Free, bold and one of a kind. Easy about it, and hard to pin down.

owl.name: Owl
owl.blurb: Careful, gentle and thoughtful. You prepare, you notice a lot, and you feel it before others do.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.blurb: Loyal, calm and organized. You keep a small circle close and look after it quietly.

bat.name: Bat
bat.blurb: Alert and exact. You keep your own hours and pick up everything that moves near you.

cat.name: Cat
cat.blurb: Patient, private and unbothered. You keep your own hours, watch first and move when it suits you.

jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
jellyfish.blurb: Dreamy and soft. You drift, you glow, and you pick up on every current around you.

sloth.name: Sloth
sloth.blurb: A slow, kind daydreamer. You move calmly and let your mind wander.

fox.name: Fox
fox.blurb: Original, private and wary. You shine on your own terms and trust your own read.

raccoon.name: Raccoon
raccoon.blurb: Clever, independent and improvising. You solve things sideways and need no one's map.

hen.name: Hen
hen.blurb: Busy, caring and watchful. You like a routine and a full yard, and a sudden noise still makes you jump.

dog.name: Dog
dog.blurb: Steady and warm. You are the one people look for, and you stay put when the weather turns.

horse.name: Horse
horse.blurb: Proud, tidy and built for the long run. Standards matter to you, and so does being heard.

ox.name: Ox
ox.blurb: Dependable and firm. You pull your share, say what you mean, and nothing moves you easily.

lamb.name: Lamb
lamb.blurb: Open-hearted and loose. You stay close to everyone, and you feel it when they drift away.

pig.name: Pig
pig.blurb: Friendly and playful. You love company, a nap and a good time, in no particular order.

goose.name: Goose
goose.blurb: Lively, loud and a bit sharp. You enjoy your flock and defend it fast.

goat.name: Goat
goat.blurb: Free, unbothered and up for anything. You live in the moment and eat whatever the day puts near you.

squirrel.name: Squirrel
squirrel.blurb: Careful and a little anxious. You like your things stored, your people few, and a plan for winter.

tortoise.name: Tortoise
tortoise.blurb: Patient, kind and steady. You take it slowly, you get there, and you carry home with you.

hedgehog.name: Hedgehog
hedgehog.blurb: Neat, spiky and guarded. You keep things in order, and you keep your distance.

badger.name: Badger
badger.blurb: Orderly and stubborn. You hold on to what you know, say it straight and dig in.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.blurb: Soft, tender and easily startled. You stay close to the ones you love and feel every rustle.

bear.name: Bear
bear.blurb: Slow, gentle and kind. You take life as it comes and make it softer for others.

deer.name: Deer
deer.blurb: Quiet, watchful and quick to bolt. You keep your distance, and you do not like being startled.

koala.name: Koala
koala.blurb: Low-key and unbothered. You keep your own counsel, rest well and let the world go by.

test.intro: Fifty short statements, one at a time. Answer how accurately each describes you as you are now, not as you would like to be. Your place is saved after every answer.
test.statementLabel: How accurately does this describe you?
test.retakeBody: You will answer all fifty questions again. Your last result stays saved, and the page will show it as "last time".
test.discardBody: The answers you have given in this sitting will be cleared.
test.savedHint: Saved on this device and synced with your account.

result.heading: Your portrait
result.trackAriaJournal: {{trait}}: you {{self}} out of 100, your journal {{journal}} out of 100.

openness.veryLow: You much prefer what is familiar, practical and proven.
openness.low: You tend to prefer the familiar and the practical.
openness.mid: You mix new ideas with what you already know.
openness.high: You are drawn to new ideas, art and experiences.
openness.veryHigh: You are hungry for new ideas, art and experiences, and always on the lookout for the next one.

conscientiousness.veryLow: You keep almost nothing fixed and go with the moment.
conscientiousness.low: You tend to keep plans loose and stay flexible.
conscientiousness.mid: You are organised in some places and relaxed in others.
conscientiousness.high: You like order, plans and following through.
conscientiousness.veryHigh: You live by order, plans and lists, and you rarely leave anything unfinished.

extraversion.veryLow: You are quiet and private, and you need plenty of time alone to recharge.
extraversion.low: You tend to be quiet and recharge on your own.
extraversion.mid: You move between company and time to yourself.
extraversion.high: You tend to seek out people and feel energised by them.
extraversion.veryHigh: You thrive around people and feel most alive in company.

agreeableness.veryLow: You say exactly what you think, however blunt, and you do not bend just to keep the peace.
agreeableness.low: You tend to say what you think, even when it is blunt.
agreeableness.mid: You balance being kind with standing your ground.
agreeableness.high: You tend to put people at ease and care how they feel.
agreeableness.veryHigh: You put other people first and go out of your way to put everyone at ease.

neuroticism.veryLow: You stay calm almost no matter what, and stress rarely shakes you.
neuroticism.low: You tend to stay steady when things get stressful.
neuroticism.mid: Stress affects you at times, and at times it does not.
neuroticism.high: You tend to feel stress and mood shifts strongly.
neuroticism.veryHigh: You feel stress and mood shifts deeply, and they can take a while to settle.

gap.close: Your journal and your answers agree on {{trait}}.
gap.journalHigher: Your journal reads as more {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.
gap.journalLower: Your journal reads as less {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.
